descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you have experience in Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), data management, projects, business control and governance for Wealth Management? We're looking for an Intern of Business Manager of GWM Brazil Platform who will:
• coordination of indication/acceptance and approvals of international events;
• coordination of indication/acceptance and approvals of local events;
• performs activities to track RMs performance, creating procedures and processes for the business development.
• aligns projects, ensures efficient use of technology.
• collaborates with internal stakeholders, product group experts, and bankers.
• coordination of and contribution to the development of a business strategy and business plan for Brazil WM
